detect: ^==\d+== (Helgrind, a thread error detector|Possible data race during|---Thread-Announcement)
parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    pre = re.compile(r'^==(\d+)== ?(.*)$')
    rx_thr = re.compile(r'^Thread #(\d+) was created')
    rx_lock = re.compile(r'^Lock at (\S+) was first observed')
    rx_race = re.compile(r'^Possible data race during (\w+) of size (\d+) at (\S+) by thread #(\d+)')
    rx_conf = re.compile(r'^This conflicts with a previous (\w+) of size (\d+) by thread #(\d+)')
    rx_locks = re.compile(r'^Locks held: (.*)$')
    rx_addr = re.compile(r'^Address \S+ .*$')
    rx_frame = re.compile(r'^(at|by) (0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+): (.*?)(?: \((.*)\))?$')
    rx_sum = re.compile(r'^ERROR SUMMARY: (\d+) errors? from (\d+) contexts?(?: \(suppressed: (\d+) from (\d+)\))?')
    rx_cmd = re.compile(r'^Command: (.*)$')
    rx_ver = re.compile(r'^Using Valgrind-(\S+)')
    threads = []; tl = []
    locks = []; ll = []
    races = []; rl = []
    frames = []; fl = []
    outs = []; ol = []
    kv = {}; kl = []
    skip = []
    ctx = ''
    race = None
    lock = None
    part = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        m = pre.match(l)
        if not m:
            if l.strip():
                outs.append({'Output': l.strip()})
                ol.append(i)
            else:
                skip.append(i)
            continue
        if 'PID' not in kv:
            kv['PID'] = m.group(1)
        t = m.group(2).strip()
        if not t or re.match(r'^-{3,}', t):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = rx_thr.match(t)
        if m:
            threads.append({'Thread': m.group(1)})
            tl.append(i)
            ctx = 'thread #' + m.group(1) + ' created'
            race = None
            lock = None
            continue
        m = rx_lock.match(t)
        if m:
            lock = {'Lock address': m.group(1), 'Description': ''}
            locks.append(lock)
            ll.append(i)
            ctx = 'lock ' + m.group(1) + ' first observed'
            race = None
            continue
        m = rx_race.match(t)
        if m:
            lock = None
            race = {'Race': str(len(races) + 1), 'Access': m.group(1), 'Size': m.group(2), 'Address': m.group(3), 'Thread': m.group(4), 'Locks held': '', 'Conflict access': '', 'Conflict size': '', 'Conflict thread': '', 'Conflict locks held': '', 'Description': ''}
            races.append(race)
            rl.append(i)
            part = 'access'
            ctx = 'race ' + race['Race'] + ' access'
            continue
        m = rx_conf.match(t)
        if m and race is not None:
            race['Conflict access'] = m.group(1)
            race['Conflict size'] = m.group(2)
            race['Conflict thread'] = m.group(3)
            rl.append(i)
            part = 'conflict'
            ctx = 'race ' + race['Race'] + ' conflict'
            continue
        m = rx_locks.match(t)
        if m and race is not None:
            race['Conflict locks held' if part == 'conflict' else 'Locks held'] = m.group(1)
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        if rx_addr.match(t):
            if lock is not None:
                lock['Description'] = t
                ll.append(i)
                continue
            if race is not None:
                race['Description'] = t
                rl.append(i)
                continue
        m = rx_frame.match(t)
        if m:
            frames.append({'Context': ctx, 'Frame': m.group(1), 'IP': m.group(2), 'Function': m.group(3), 'Location': m.group(4) or ''})
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = rx_sum.match(t)
        if m:
            kv['Errors'] = m.group(1)
            kv['Contexts'] = m.group(2)
            kv['Suppressed errors'] = m.group(3) or ''
            kv['Suppressed contexts'] = m.group(4) or ''
            kl.append(i)
            continue
        m = rx_cmd.match(t)
        if m:
            kv['Command'] = m.group(1)
            kl.append(i)
            continue
        m = rx_ver.match(t)
        if m:
            kv['Valgrind version'] = m.group(1)
            kl.append(i)
            continue
        skip.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if kv:
        blocks.append({'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kl, 'records': [kv]})
    if threads:
        blocks.append({'name': 'threads', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tl, 'records': threads})
    if locks:
        blocks.append({'name': 'locks', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ll, 'records': locks})
    if races:
        blocks.append({'name': 'races', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': rl, 'records': races})
    if frames:
        blocks.append({'name': 'frames', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': frames})
    if outs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'program_output', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ol, 'records': outs})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
